title: Anisotropic Material
content: Some surfaces reflect a different value depending on the angle they're seen by the viewer. This surface property is calledanisotropic.Such materials include brushed stainless steel (above), horse hair, velvet (below), wood grain, or a wet road.Bearded Man with a Velvet Cap,1645,Govert FlinckDutch, Met Museum, NYRead more at theWikipedia page on Anisotropy
